points.description: States that the queue is implemented as a circular array, i.e. the rear/end index wraps around to the beginning of the array when it reaches the end (front toward the beginning, rear toward the end).
points.partial_credit: Award 2–3 marks if the answer describes using an array with front and rear indices but does not mention wrapping around/circular behaviour, or mentions wrap-around only vaguely.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the array is used circularly, with the rear (or indices) wrapping around to the start, in any wording (e.g. "circular queue", "loop back to the beginning"). Part marks for a plain array with front and rear pointers but no wrap-around idea. No marks for unrelated answers such as linked lists or only stating that enqueue/dequeue exist.
